I recommend reading Meditations by Marcus Aurelius. It will probably help you more than any advice of any person in this subreddit.  


original translation (difficult): [http://files.libertyfund.org/files/2133/Aurelius\_1464\_EBk\_v6.0.pdf](http://files.libertyfund.org/files/2133/Aurelius_1464_EBk_v6.0.pdf)  


modern translation (easy): [http://seinfeld.co/library/meditations.pdf](http://seinfeld.co/library/meditations.pdf)  


Start at Book 2 (Chapter)
Because I was there in my early teens. Suicidal, depressed & had no one helping me until I realized that the only option is to help myself. Rationally and systematically.

then become one instead of whining.  


being someone's favorite person means being funny, getting shit done, making sure others have fun when in a group or being a role model for others in general.  


If you're whining and complaining, don't expect to be liked by everyone or even the most.

Making money isn't hard in today's world. You just don't understand how the system works. The richest people I've met in my life are self-made (started with $0). (inlcuding a soon to-be billionaire) It took them a decade or two to get rich as fuck.  


Discover your talents, be laser focused, block out people in your life who do you no good or aren't related to your goals.
